name: toru
description: Record polished product demo videos with your agent, signed in as you.

interface.longDescription: Toru lets your agent record a product demo in a browser you sign in to yourself (or a window on your Mac), then renders a polished MP4 with cursor motion and zooms. The plugin bundles the Toru skill and the hosted MCP server configuration.
defaultPrompt: Record a demo video of my web app.
Check a Toru recording and get the MP4.
Record a window on my Mac.
